label: A
name: N Seoul Tower
description: A panoramic Seoul viewpoint on Namsan with a clear sunset-to-night transition.
voiceCaption: As daylight leaves the city, the Han River and Seoul's ridgelines begin to separate into layers of light.

hours.note: Last observatory admission is 30 minutes before closing. Hours can change with weather and operations.

cost.note: The outdoor plaza is free. Observatory admission and transport are optional.

localHelper: The Namsan Ormi inclined elevator is free. It is suspended Mondays 09:00–14:00 for maintenance and may stop in strong wind or heavy rain.
accessibility: Elevator information is available inside the tower; verify the selected walking approach before departure.

source.label: N Seoul Tower official visitor information

label: B
name: Bukchon Hanok Village
description: A living residential neighborhood where tiled hanok roofs frame the downtown skyline.
voiceCaption: Bukchon is beautiful because it is still a neighborhood. Walk quietly, keep doorways clear, and photograph the streets with care.

hours.note: Sunday is an alley rest day. Bukchon-ro 11-gil's red zone is restricted from 17:00 to 10:00; violations can be fined KRW 100,000.

cost.note: Walking through the village is free. Individual workshops and museums may charge separately.

localHelper: This is a residential area. Keep voices low, do not look into homes, and avoid blocking narrow lanes.
accessibility: The area includes steep slopes, steps, and narrow lanes. Check a step-free route before visiting.

source.label: Seoul Metropolitan Government Bukchon visitor notice

label: C
name: Cheonggyecheon Stream
description: A low, walkable stream corridor through central Seoul with bridges, reflections, and evening light.
voiceCaption: A few steps below street level, the sound of traffic softens and central Seoul follows the stream instead.

hours.note: Access may be restricted during rain for safety.

localHelper: There are multiple subway access points along the stream. Choose the entry closest to the scene you want to see.
accessibility: Use signed ramp entrances; some stair-only entrances are not step-free.

label: D
name: Seoullo 7017
description: An elevated pedestrian path linking Seoul Station to nearby neighborhoods and city viewpoints.
voiceCaption: This former overpass now lets you cross the city slowly, above traffic and between Seoul Station's old and new faces.

hours.note: Individual cafés and facilities keep separate operating hours.

localHelper: Seoullo has multiple access points around Seoul Station, Namdaemun Market, and Malli-dong.
accessibility: Use signed elevator access points around Seoul Station and Malli-dong; verify the nearest operating elevator before departure.
